scope: Statutory-benefit sales in API intake and invoice creation, merchant reports and admin transaction/document filters and exports
calculation: Integer centavos, eligible lines only, no stacked promotional discounts. Senior/PWD 20% with covered VAT exemption; national athletes/coaches 20% with VAT retained; qualified solo parents 10% with covered VAT exemption. Non-VAT sellers never remove fictitious VAT.
eligibility: Recorded identity, evidence, covered scope and merchant confirmation required. Solo-parent benefits additionally require child age, valid SPIC, booklet and income confirmation. Application validation does not replace merchant inspection of actual eligibility evidence.
exclusions: Separate 5% basic-necessities and utility discount programs are not implemented
No automatic entitlement for all products
No real beneficiary data, billable sale or BIR transmission used for acceptance testing

verification.documented_examples: 10 payloads validated against frontend and PHP calculations
visual_checks: Shared form for PWD, athlete/coach and solo parent
One-page sample invoice and filtered report
42-page developer manual, new pages 38–42 rendered and inspected
coverage: No beneficiary IDs in bulk reports

rollout: Private backup, checksummed allowlist, additive resumable migration, fresh read-only verification and preserved old financial/account records; standing deployment authorization
